parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The visibility of the image. This parameter is valid only for custom images.

*   PUBLIC: The image is visible to all users.
*   PRIVATE: The image is visible only to you and the administrator of the workspace.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description:
The tag filter conditions. Multiple conditions are separated by commas (,). The format of a single condition filter is `key=value`. The following keys are supported:

*   system.chipType
*   system.dsw.cudaVersion
*   system.dsw.fromImageId
*   system.dsw.fromInstanceId
*   system.dsw.id
*   system.dsw.os
*   system.dsw.osVersion
*   system.dsw.resourceType
*   system.dsw.rootImageId
*   system.dsw.stage
*   system.dsw.tag
*   system.dsw.type
*   system.framework
*   system.origin
*   system.pythonVersion
*   system.source
*   system.supported.dlc
*   system.supported.dsw

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The image name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The order in which the entries are sorted by the specific field on the returned page. This parameter must be used together with SortBy. Default value: ASC. Valid values:

*   ASC: ascending order
*   DESC: descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The image name and description that are used for fuzzy search.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field used for sorting. The GmtCreateTime field is used.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display non-essential information, which contains tags. Valid values:

*   true
*   false

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. You can call [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) to obtain the workspace ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-images --name tensorflow_2.9 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --labels system.framework=XGBoost_1.6.0,system.official=true --verbose true --workspace-id 2000000055 --query name --accessibility PUBLIC --image-uri example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/images --region cn-hangzhou --Order DESC --PageSize 20 --Verbose true --Query name --Accessibility PUBLIC --PageNumber 1 --SortBy GmtCreateTime --WorkspaceId 2000000055 --Labels 'system.framework=XGBoost_1.6.0,system.official=true' --ImageUri 'example-string' --Name 'tensorflow_2.9' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
